# Crates the Reverie cell's BUCK files name without a version suffix.
#
# Reverie's first-party BUCK files say `fbsource//third-party/rust:thiserror`,
# the same spelling Meta's internal build uses. Reindeer only emits such an
# unsuffixed alias for crates that are direct dependencies of the manifest it
# ran on, so Hermit's cell has aliases for Hermit's direct dependencies and not
# for Reverie's. That gap is the only thing that stopped one cell from serving
# both; there is no version conflict behind it.
#
# bootstrap/regenerate-rust-deps appends one alias per line below, resolving
# each to whatever versioned target the generated BUCK actually contains, so a
# version bump does not silently strand an entry -- a missing crate is an error.
#
# Reindeer has no configuration for this: buckify.rs gates alias emission on
# `index.is_public_target`, which is derived from the manifest's own direct
# dependencies and is not configurable.
byteorder
bytes
derive_more
kvm-bindings
kvm-ioctls
linked-hash-map
liteinst2
memmap2
never-say-never
num-traits
parking_lot
paste
perf-event-open-sys
thiserror
tokio-stream
typed-arena
unwind
